assumptions.choice: Access sentiment data from self.datas[1].close if multiple data feeds are passed, else from self.data.sentiment if present as a line, else fall back to self.data.close.
assumptions.reason: The specification mentions a separate 15-minute sentiment data series, while the execution environment notes a single data feed self.data with standard OHLCV columns.

assumptions.choice: Calculate upper/lower Donchian bands using highest high and lowest low over the preceding 20 bars (self.data.high(-1) and self.data.low(-1)).
assumptions.reason: Including the current bar in the high/low range calculation makes close[0] strictly less than or equal to upper[0], which would mathematically prevent a close crossover above upper[0].

assumptions.choice: Set base_size = 1 and round calculated position_size to integer with a minimum of 1 share.
assumptions.reason: The specification details the position_size scaling formula using base_size but does not state a numerical value for base_size.

assumptions.choice: Set stop-loss order in notify_order upon entry completion using order.executed.price and current ATR.
assumptions.reason: The specification dictates setting stop-loss relative to exact entry_price, which is finalized when the entry order is executed.
